title: How you see them
blurb: Daily only. Questions about the other person, never yourself, and only the kind ones.

questions.text: What do they do better than anyone else you know?
When did they last make an ordinary day better without meaning to?
What is something they're quietly proud of that they never mention?
What would their friends be surprised to learn about them?
What do they make look easy that isn't?
Where have you seen them change the most since you met?
